note: Compiler is a pure developer framework: it registers a 'compiler' plugin type (manager service plugin.manager.compiler = Drupal\compiler\Plugin\CompilerPluginManager, discovery subdir Plugin/Compiler, annotation @Compiler which is a PluginID, interface CompilerPluginInterface::compile(), alter hook hook_compiler_info, cache bin compiler_plugins) plus context/input value objects (CompilerContext, RefineableCompilerContext, CompilerInputFile, CompilerInputDirect). It ships NO compiler plugins, no config, no routes, no UI, no permissions, no Drush. Concrete compiler plugins come from other modules; on this site the enabled compiler_scss module registers an 'scss' compiler plugin. easy = recipe facts about the plugin type/API. medium = introspect the live plugin manager (its class, the registered plugin ids). hard = the agent writes a real compiler plugin in a custom module (compiler_probe) so it becomes discoverable and its compile() returns a known value, verified against the live manager.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module 'compiler', how do I register a new compiler? Name the plugin namespace/subdirectory a plugin class must live in, the annotation it uses, the interface it must implement, and the plugin manager service id.
evals.expected_output: Create a class in your module's src/Plugin/Compiler/ directory, annotate it @Compiler("id") (a PluginID annotation), implement Drupal\compiler\Plugin\CompilerPluginInterface (compile()) — optionally extending CompilerPluginBase. The manager is the service plugin.manager.compiler (Drupal\compiler\Plugin\CompilerPluginManager). Discovery can be altered with hook_compiler_info().

evals.prompt: Using the Drupal 'compiler' module's plugin manager, how do I run a compiler plugin by its machine name against some inputs and get the compiled result?
evals.expected_output: Build a CompilerContext (or RefineableCompilerContext) with the compiler id, options, and inputs, then call \Drupal::service('plugin.manager.compiler')->createInstance($id)->compile($context). compile() returns the compiled result.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal 'compiler' module, what is the difference between CompilerContext and RefineableCompilerContext, and what are CompilerInputFile and CompilerInputDirect used for?
evals.expected_output: CompilerContext is immutable (compiler id, options, inputs, data set at construction). RefineableCompilerContext extends it and is mutable via ArrayAccess plus setCompiler/setData/setOption(s). Inputs implement CompilerInputInterface: CompilerInputFile wraps a file path, CompilerInputDirect wraps a raw value; both return it via get(). Iterate them with $context->getInputs().

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, inspect the service container: what PHP class backs the compiler module's plugin manager service (plugin.manager.compiler)?
evals.expected_output: The service plugin.manager.compiler is an instance of Drupal\compiler\Plugin\CompilerPluginManager (a DefaultPluginManager subclass). Discoverable via drush php:eval 'echo get_class(\Drupal::service("plugin.manager.compiler"));'.

evals.prompt: On this running Drupal site, inspect the compiler plugin manager and report which compiler plugin id(s) are currently registered (discovered) by it.
evals.expected_output: Query \Drupal::service('plugin.manager.compiler')->getDefinitions(); the compiler module ships none itself, but the enabled compiler_scss module registers the 'scss' compiler plugin, so 'scss' is the registered id.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, using the 'compiler' module's plugin type, create and enable a small custom module named 'compiler_probe' that registers a compiler plugin with the id 'probe_compiler' (a class in Drupal\compiler_probe\Plugin\Compiler annotated @Compiler("probe_compiler"), implementing CompilerPluginInterface / extending CompilerPluginBase). After enabling and rebuilding caches, the compiler plugin manager must discover 'probe_compiler'. Apply this to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A module compiler_probe with src/Plugin/Compiler/ProbeCompiler.php (@Compiler("probe_compiler")) is enabled; \Drupal::service('plugin.manager.compiler')->hasDefinition('probe_compiler') returns TRUE after drush cr.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create and enable a custom module 'compiler_probe' providing a compiler plugin with id 'probe_compiler' whose compile(CompilerContextInterface $context) method returns a string containing the token PROBE_OK. Verify by instantiating it through plugin.manager.compiler and calling compile() on a context. Apply this to the live site.
evals.expected_output: compiler_probe registers probe_compiler; \Drupal::service('plugin.manager.compiler')->createInstance('probe_compiler')->compile($context) returns a string containing 'PROBE_OK'.
